shortDesc: VS Code extension sandbox exploring editor customizations.
fullDesc:
A sandbox development repository demonstrating how to write custom extension commands, workspace helpers, and UI widgets using the VS Code Extension API.

Core Idea:
The project serves as a reference implementation for extension capabilities, exploring sidebar integrations, status bar buttons, custom commands, and context menus to enrich developer workflows.
highlights: Reference implementations of custom VS Code API integrations
Automated commands, shortcuts, and diagnostics examples
Lightweight and structured code suitable for extension bootstrapping
